objective: HR Specialist and HR Administrator roles are granted only after the user's manager and the ISSO approve a documented request
assessment_objects: Role grant records, access request tickets, Access Control Policy

objective: Enabled local, service, and break-glass accounts are disabled after 35 days without activity, unless a documented exception applies
assessment_objects: Account listing pulled while the assessor watched

objective: System administrators hold no HR application role, and HR staff have no infrastructure access
Everyone who holds an HR or administrator role on the portal passed security awareness training in the last 12 months
assessment_objects: Training completion export, role assignment export

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
objective: The ISSO reviews portal-specific audit logs every week and records each review
assessment_objects: Weekly review tickets, interview with the ISSO

objective: Changes to the portal are approved and tested before they are implemented
The load balancer offers only TLS 1.2 or higher, as the SSP requires
The contingency plan has been tested and the results recorded
assessment_objects: Contingency plan test records, interview with the system owner

objective: The Enterprise Identity Service enforces MFA for every portal sign-in under a current authorization
assessment_objects: Provider authorization summary, portal access policy confirmation

objective: Every asset in the boundary gets a successful credentialed scan each week
Open flaws are fixed within 15, 30, 60, or 90 days for Critical, High, Moderate, or Low severity
SOC detections for the portal produce tickets, and at least 95% are triaged within the SLA
assessment_objects: SOC alert summary, interview with the SOC manager
